name: Rule
label: Rule
description: Declarative rule that fires on a dispatched entity lifecycle event (validate, before_save, on_update, before_submit, on_submit, before_cancel — plus file-authored on_workflow_transition:<from>:<to>) and executes an ordered list of actions. Actions run INSIDE the triggering document's MongoDB transaction — all effects roll back together on any error. create_document and update_document are governed (they flow through the full DocumentService pipeline); update_document patches the allow_on_submit band of an already-submitted target; set_value is an in-memory pre-write mutation (validate/before_submit only); validate throws to abort. Seeded from `<appDir>/rules/**.rule.json` files; admin UI stores overrides in this collection.

fields.label: Entity
fields.description: The entity whose lifecycle event triggers this rule (the doctype name).

fields.label: Event
fields.description: The dispatched lifecycle event that triggers this rule. Dynamic workflow-transition events (on_workflow_transition:<from>:<to>) fire too but are file-authored only — a Select cannot enumerate them.

fields.label: Priority
fields.description: Lower runs first when multiple rules fire on the same event.

fields.label: Condition
fields.description: Expression against `doc`. Rule skips when it evaluates false. E.g. `doc.docstatus == 1`.

fields.label: Overridden
fields.description: Set true when admin UI edits a seeded rule; boot skips re-seed for these.

fields.label: Actions
fields.description: Executed in order inside the parent transaction.

child_fields.label: Target Name (expr)
child_fields.description: Expression that resolves to the target document's _id.

child_fields.label: Iterate (path)
child_fields.description: When set on create_document, iterates the array at this path (e.g. `doc.lines`) and emits one doc per row. Inside mappings, `row.field` is available.

child_fields.label: Field Mappings (expressions)
child_fields.description: { targetField: expression } map. Only for create_document + update_document. Values are rule expressions or $-tokens ($now[±ISO-dur], $root.*, $user.*).

child_fields.label: Field
child_fields.description: For set_value — target field on the current doc.

child_fields.label: Value (expr)
child_fields.description: For set_value — expression to compute the value.

child_fields.label: Condition (expr)
child_fields.description: For validate — action fails when this evaluates false.

child_fields.label: Message
child_fields.description: For validate — shown when the condition fails; preferred over error_message.

child_fields.label: Error Message
child_fields.description: For validate — message shown when condition fails (deprecated — kept for existing rows).
